metadata.head: cfb050ca
metadata.description: Comprehensive categorization of all Minecraft features into Core, Content, and Utility for client and server

core.description: Core features required for basic Minecraft functionality

server.name: World Generation - Terrain
server.notes: Base terrain heightmap generation with multi-layered noise

server.name: World Generation - Caves
server.notes: Hydrology-aware cave generation with edge sealing, support pillars, riparian cave plugging, wet ceiling sealing

server.name: World Generation - Rivers
server.notes: Hydrology-driven river generation with flow-aware width modulation, confluence boost, headwater stability

server.name: World Generation - Lakes
server.notes: Lake basin generation with outflow channel carving, edge normalization, river suppression

server.name: World Generation - Biomes
server.notes: Temperature/humidity gradient-based biome placement with transition smoothing

server.name: World Generation - Ore Distribution
server.notes: Ore vein generation needs improvement, missing ore clustering, no depth-based distribution

server.name: Networking - Protocol Registry
server.notes: Central message type registration with validation

server.name: Networking - Protocol Handler
server.notes: Enhanced protocol handler with descriptor validation, size limits, compression, statistics tracking

server.name: Networking - Login Handler
server.notes: Authentication and session management with username/password, salted hashing, session tokens

server.name: World Map Control - Controller
server.notes: Server world map control with profiles, state versioning, diff-based synchronization

server.name: World Map Control - Chunk Sync
server.notes: Chunk, entity, and block synchronization coordinators

server.name: Player Systems - Authentication
server.notes: Player authentication, session management, player data initialization

server.name: Block System - Data Management
server.notes: Block type definitions and data management

client.name: World Map Control - Controller
client.notes: Client world map control mirroring server state

content.description: Content features that add gameplay elements

server.name: Items - Tool Tiers
server.notes: Complete tool tier system (wood, stone, iron, diamond, netherite)

server.name: Items - Weapons & Armor
server.notes: Weapon damage calculations, armor protection values

server.name: Crafting - Advanced
server.notes: Advanced recipe system, recipe book, crafting queue

server.name: Mobs - AI Systems
server.notes: Hostile and passive mob AI, breeding, taming, pathfinding

server.name: Structures - Generation
server.notes: Village, temple, mineshaft, dungeon, stronghold generation

server.name: Structures - Building System
server.notes: Building system with blueprints, multi-block structures

server.name: World Features - Advanced
server.notes: Advanced weather effects, seasonal changes, dimension system

client.name: Crafting - Advanced UI
client.notes: Recipe book interface, crafting queue, auto-crafting

client.name: Player - Controller
client.notes: Player controller for movement and actions

utility.description: Utility features that support development and maintenance

server.name: Configuration - Advanced
server.notes: Configuration migration system, schema validation, backup/restore

server.name: Database - SQLite
server.notes: SQLite database integration for player data

server.name: Server Management - Advanced
server.notes: Advanced permissions, backup/restore, remote admin, plugins, anti-cheat

server.name: Development Tools - Advanced
server.notes: World editor, resource packs, mod support, profiling, network debugging

server.name: Performance - Optimization
server.notes: Network bandwidth optimization, memory usage, multithreading, database queries

client.name: UI - Basic
client.notes: Login UI, status displays, basic inventory UI

client.name: UI - Advanced
client.notes: Advanced inventory, crafting interface, map system, settings menu, statistics, achievements, tutorial, accessibility

client.name: World Map Control - UI
client.notes: Runtime controls and diagnostics for hydrology/cave/river toggles

client.name: Performance - Optimization
client.notes: Rendering performance, asset loading, chunk culling, mesh generation
